name: one label set from prometheus_client for python
why: prometheus_client 0.26.0 writes 18 series for one label set of a default histogram: 15 buckets with +Inf, _count, _sum and _created (observability-driven/series_cost.py). 18 / 15 s = 1.2 samples/s; x 86,400 = 103,680 a day; x 15 days, Prometheus's default retention, = 1,555,200 samples, 1.6 to 3.1 MB.

name: a tenant label with 500 values
why: The same client with 500 tenant values writes 9,000 series (series_cost.py). 500 label sets is past Prometheus's 'investigate anything over 100'. 9,000 / 15 = 600/s; 51,840,000 a day; 777,600,000 kept, 778 MB to 1.6 GB.
